voiceoverScript: A pothole can leave the visible wheel face looking normal. That does not clear the inner barrel or lip. Hidden damage can affect how the assembly runs. Vibration or repeated air loss are useful clues. Inspect the whole wheel and tire, not one side.
selectedCaption: Wheel damage can occur on the inboard barrel or inner lip where it is hard to see and can contribute to vibration or air loss. A wheel can look fine from the face and still be bent on the hidden inner lip. Nick's Tire & Auto can inspect the actual vehicle or tire before parts are replaced.
